text.description_html:
Arched Style Solid Cast Bronze Refrigerator/Appliance Pull

15" Arched Style pull for your refrigerator or other appliance, cast in solid bronze with high quality craftsmanship. This stunning pull features a curved design that is a pleasing o the eye as it is to the hand. The Hamilton AP-114.15 pulls are packaged standard for Thrubolt Mounting for a Refrigerator/Appliance panel.

Specifications of the bronze appliance pulls:

  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Length c.c.: 15"
  • Projection: 2-1/8" to 2-1/2"
  • Pull Diameter: 5/8"
  • Bronze Patina finish over Solid Cast Bronze
  • Hamilton AP-114 Specifications (PDF).

Sold Individually

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only 1 Left.
